about: Bennitta Joseph is a partner at Norinsberg Law in New York, New York. Over a distinguished legal career spanning more than two decades, she has earned a reputation as a formidable trial attorney, providing fierce courtroom advocacy for victims of civil rights violations, workplace injustices, sexual assault and catastrophic personal injuries.
Ms. Joseph maintains a versatile, plaintiff-focused trial practice across several key litigation areas:

Ms. Joseph’s trial preparation and advocacy skills were cultivated through an expansive academic background. She attended Howard University, earning a Bachelor’s degree in the administration of justice in 1994, where she served as Captain of the Mock Trial Team. She pursued her legal education at the Temple University James E. Beasley School of Law, earning her Juris Doctor in 1997. During law school, she honed her litigation skills as a standout member of the nationally renowned Temple Trial Team.

Admitted to the New York State Bar Association in 1999, Ms. Joseph entered private practice after developing foundational courtroom experience as a prosecutor. Her prosecutorial background instills a sharp, evidence-driven approach to every case, enabling her to dismantle complex defense strategies effectively.

Ms. Joseph combines sophisticated legal strategy with an uncompromising commitment to her clients. Whether holding powerful corporations accountable or fighting for maximum compensation for the injured, she provides the confident, high-level advocacy required to achieve justice in New York's state and federal courts.
